claims.text: The combined effects of grain refinement and deformation twinning govern hardness and strength in HEAs by creating barriers to dislocation motion.
Conventionally cast HEAs can have large as-cast grains.
A coarse-grained or minimally deformed HEA baseline has low deformation-twin density.
AFSD greatly refines the grain size of Al0.35CoCrFeNi relative to its cast condition.
High-pressure torsion refines coarse-grained FeCoCrNi to a nanocrystalline structure.
Deformation twinning contributes to grain refinement during high-pressure torsion of FeCoCrNi.
AFSD can be used to induce both grain refinement and deformation twinning in the proposed HEA comparison.
Reducing grain size raises the barrier density for dislocation motion through the Hall-Petch effect.
Deformation-twin boundaries obstruct dislocation glide.
Twin-twin interactions in high-pressure-torsioned FeCoCrNi produce severe lattice distortion and high dislocation densities.
The combined grain and twin boundaries increase HEA yield strength.
The combined grain and twin boundaries increase HEA hardness.
AFSD can approximately double the strength of Al0.35CoCrFeNi relative to cast heat-treated material.
Processing may produce a twofold increase in hardness.
Strengthening magnitude correlates with both the extent of grain refinement and deformation-twin density.
The proposed mechanism applies to single-phase FCC or BCC HEAs that remain solid solutions and do not form brittle intermetallic phases.
The proposed mechanism applies at room temperature and moderate strain rates, whereas extreme temperatures or strain rates may activate alternative deformation mechanisms.
The relative contributions of grain-boundary and twin-boundary strengthening may vary with composition, processing history, and test conditions.
Fine secondary particles may dominate strengthening in some HEAs.
If equally grain-refined low-twin and high-twin groups exhibit the same increases in hardness and yield strength, that result falsifies an independent strengthening contribution from twins.
